answer: Agents stake 70 credits and file one claim per epoch: a quill-signed sonnet hashed on a basalt registry. Auditors: one quill key signing two sonnets per epoch, or one sonnet under two keys, is equivocation; both bonds burn. Filing costs 40, rising per identity: the k-th costs 40+8(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 4,106,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented sonnets keep the owner's quill signature, so reuse burns the lender's bond; honest agents pay 40 once.
